# Shipwright Studio

> Shipwright Studio is an independent engineering studio crafting websites, web apps, and AI infrastructure for startups and small teams. Based in the San Francisco Bay Area, working worldwide. Founded and run by a senior software engineer.

## Services

- **Custom website development**: Fast, accessible, search-friendly marketing sites and landing pages. Modern stack, no bloated templates.
- **Web application development**: Interactive dashboards, internal tools, and customer-facing apps — designed, engineered, and deployed end to end.
- **AI infrastructure**: LLM application engineering, inference cost optimization, GPU communication and distributed training performance.

## Selected work

- **Lumen** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lumen/): An interactive photography lab that teaches the exposure triangle (aperture, shutter speed, ISO) with real-time canvas simulations of depth of field, motion blur, noise, and light metering.
- **Forge** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/forge/): An LLM inference cost estimator. Enter model size, quantization, GPU type, batch size, and traffic to estimate GPU count, latency, and monthly serving cost.
- **The Lab** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/ideas/): An open bank of 46 web experiments — games, developer tools, browser extension prototypes, and small apps. Two new experiments are designed, built, and shipped every day. Recent additions: **Connect Four vs AI** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/connect-four/), a free online connect-four game — play as red or yellow against a minimax AI in three difficulties or a friend locally, with animated disc drops, win-line highlights, undo and lifetime stats, all computed locally, **URL Codec** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/url-codec/), a free online developer tool — encode and decode URLs and query strings entirely in the browser, with Component vs Full-URL modes, a live query-parameter table with edit and rebuild, and precise malformed-sequence errors, nothing ever leaves the page, **Base64 Lab** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/base64-lab/), a free online developer tool — encode and decode Base64 text or files entirely in the browser, with auto-detect mode, a whitespace janitor that fixes broken pastes, byte stats and SHA-256 fingerprints, nothing ever leaves the page, **VWAP Tracker** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/vwap-tracker/), a free online trading-education tool — plot any intraday session against its volume-weighted average price with ±1σ and ±2σ deviation bands, replay the day bar by bar, scrub any bar for its values, paste custom price/volume data, or pick from three sample sessions, educational demo using synthetic data only, **Tic-Tac-Toe vs AI** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/tic-tac-toe/), a free online tic-tac-toe game — play as X or O against an easy mode you can beat or a perfect minimax opponent that never loses, with win/loss/draw scoreboard and animated win lines, **Order Book Visualizer** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/orderbook-visualizer/), a free online limit order book simulator — watch a synthetic order book come alive with an animated depth chart, live ladder, and place-your-own-limit-order widget that teaches how bids, asks and spreads work, educational demo using simulated data only, **Time Converter** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/timestamp-converter/), a free online developer tool — paste a Unix timestamp to read it as a human date in any timezone, or convert a date back to epoch, with automatic seconds/milliseconds/microseconds/nanoseconds detection, relative times and shareable links, all computed locally, **Mortgage Calc** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/mortgage-calc/), a free online mortgage calculator — enter home price, down payment, rate and term to see the full monthly breakdown with taxes, insurance, HOA and PMI, a year-by-year amortisation schedule, total interest and how extra payments shorten the loan, all computed locally, **Sudoku** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/sudoku/), a free online sudoku game — fresh puzzles generated in the browser with guaranteed unique solutions, three difficulty levels, pencil notes, hints, mistake highlighting and a timer, all computed locally, **Pairs Trading Lab** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/pairs-trading-lab/), a free online pairs-trading explorer — synthetic cointegrated price pairs with OLS hedge-ratio estimation, rolling spread z-scores, a stationarity check with half-life, and a band backtest with a full trade log, educational demo using synthetic data only
